diagnostics.message: Semicolon present; review for clause stacking.
diagnostics.text: The definition-matched debt-financing pulse increased slightly to 0.5, and lender strain also edged up, to 20.1. The Chicago Fed’s NFCI remains negative at -0.46, but its 0.07 rise over three months was material, consistent with somewhat firmer financial conditions. Bloomberg reported that Oracle is offering $10 billion of high-grade dollar bonds, while Reuters reported concern that AI-related debt could pressure European bond markets. The developments show issuance continuing alongside concern about how markets absorb additional debt; they do not establish a broad credit disruption.

diagnostics.message: Semicolon present; review for clause stacking.
diagnostics.text: Commercial electricity demand is growing 3.5%, versus 1.8% for total retail demand, while retail electricity prices are up 5.1%. Utility Dive reported that PSEG Power plans a 200 MW nuclear uprate as it considers data-center deals. The reported uprate gives a defined project and scale, although it remains planned. Across the broader pipeline horizon, net planned generation additions total 227.6 GW. The PSEG report ties one proposed project to potential data-center business; the aggregate demand and price figures do not isolate AI’s role.

diagnostics.text: Financing remains active, but the indicators have become somewhat firmer. Bloomberg reported Oracle’s $10 billion high-grade bond offering; Reuters separately reported concern that AI-related debt could pressure European bond markets. The reports show issuance coming to market alongside greater attention to debt absorption, but they do not establish a broad credit break.
